theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RT : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Rs : ℝ → IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ t, (Rs t).carrier ⊆ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Rs t).measure W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Rs t).measure W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * RT.measure W) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Integrable (fun s => (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)))) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∫ s in a..b, (Rs s).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = (b - a) * ((∫ x in RT.carrier, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 2]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * min 1 (max 0 ((b - f x) / (b - a))) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1])
